title: Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 Switzerland approved 57 partner jurisdictions, including all EU states and the UK, for automatic crypto tax data exchanges under the OECD's CARF from 2028. This post Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
